subject: history_social
passage: The Karakoram Highway, which links Pakistan and China, climbs to more than 4,600 meters at the Khunjerab ______ it is one of the highest paved international roads in the world.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The text has two complete sentences: "The Karakoram Highway … climbs to more than 4,600 meters at the Khunjerab Pass" and "it is one of the highest paved international roads in the world." Two independent clauses can be joined with a semicolon.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A comma alone can't join two independent clauses; this creates a comma splice.
explanation.B: Correct. A semicolon correctly joins two closely related independent clauses.
explanation.C: Incorrect. When "and" joins two independent clauses, a comma is needed before it.
explanation.D: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the two independent clauses run together.

checks.note: Best fit on the text alone.
